provenance.notes: Original Radio style TypeScript including component-token defaults, original CSS-mode calculator and cssinjs serializer; React hook registration captured and concrete aliases supplied by independently executed theme fixtures. Static DOM follows original Radio, Radio.Button and Radio.Group classes and input/label structure. Hover/active/focus-visible selectors are deterministically activated by equivalent data selectors after original CSS serialization. No Rust style values or behavior are used. Default, wireframe and source component-token customization matrices are measured.
